caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with armrests, a high backrest, and a woven seat. The bench is colored in different shades of brown, with darker tones on the frame and slightly lighter hues on the woven seat, which shows signs of wear and irregularity. The high backrest features a central cut-out in the shape of a heart and a row of evenly spaced spindles below it. The legs and armrests are rounded, and the posts are topped with finials. The overall composition centers the bench on a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Wagon Seat
